headline: Degrees don't build things. People do.
subhead: Building something unconventional at 18 to 35? Pull up a chair.
caption: One of XOOTEQ's beliefs: degrees don't build things, people do. Build With Us gives builders aged 18 to 35 workspace, living space, hardware, GPU access, dev infrastructure and peers. Tell us what you've built before and what you need: hello@xooteq.com. We reply to everyone.
